text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Early February, huh? That's right, Acute-san!
When you think of events around this time—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day?!
Not Setsubun?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Setsubun is overwhelmingly the most popular one, right?
You throw beans, and then everyone eats inari sushi together, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“Still, eeeveryone's going on and on
about Valentine's Day, huh?
Wondering who they should give chocolates to~.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “I see... That might've been a bit of a blind spot for me. Valentine's Day—an event where you give chocolate to someone important.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That part's the main focus.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui says handmade chocolate needs to firmly capture
the other person's heart, right?
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this.
Give me a hand, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —What do you think is the single most important thing to capture someone's heart, Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Umm, sincerity?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sincerity is sincerity, but strictly speaking,
I think it's about "maximizing sincerity through feng shui"☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, chocolate has been known to soothe the mind
and induce relaxation. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Once their guard is down, if we deliver genuine sincerity amplified by feng shui, making them completely enamored should be quite simple."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if I properly source the ingredients from an auspicious direction
and coat them in pink chocolate—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is guaranteed to win the Trainer's heart!
That's the Feng Shui-style Valentine for you♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm gonna make
the ultimate happy chocolates☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The strongest chocolate?
Sounds kinda beefy and muscular, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —February 14th. Having finished the paperwork required for the race, I was walking to submit it when—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morning! I brought
something pretty neat today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Copano Rickey and Wonder Acute have arrived. I wonder what 'good stuff' they brought?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that! I helped out too,
and we made something suuuper delicious, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Come, Rickey-chan, now is the time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! Um, um um um!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Here! What's inside is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Inari Sushi Set ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Out of nowhere... I was handed an assorted plate of inari sushi.
choice_data_list: Inari sushi!? And it's a whole set?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! They say eating this after Setsubun brings a whole heap of happiness, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So eat up☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um? Rickey-chan,
what about the chocolates we made together~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Shh, shh! You don't have to say anything,
Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hae~, did something happen? Don't tell me
you kept it so warm and cozy that it melted?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's not it~
I'm not melting or anything, but... um...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: When I really think about it, giving chocolate to my Trainer is just embarrassing, you know...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I think it's better to wait on the chocolate
until our fortune and momentum rise a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Trainer!
Make sure to eat your inari sushi set, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna go have some tea over there.
...With chocolate. See ya! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Copano Rickey left behind a set of inari sushi before walking away.
The inari sushi was delicious nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaaawn*, good morning, Trainer~
It's finally... finally finished~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Try eating this. It's the pinnacle of feng shui power.
It should change the world before your very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unusually serious look in Copano Rickey's eyes.
And today is Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening it up, inside was indeed handmade chocolate.
Taking a bite right then and there...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well? Are you starting to get that...
sort of mysterious vibe!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like, "I want to do my absolute best for them!"
or "I'll dedicate my whole life to them!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Is your heart completely
painted in Rickey's colors now?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Then...! That means it's a huge success☆
Yaaay!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is Valentine's Day, Feng Shui style♪
It can break through any emotional barrier, no matter how high!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or ratherâ
choice_data_list: I've always felt that way, though.
I've always felt that way, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the whole time...?
Like, even before eating the chocolate?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because Rickey has always been my top priority.
Yeah, I've always put Ricky first, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is nothing out of the ordinary.
A Trainer's duty is to always put their Umamusume's future first."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “I see... So that's it... If that's the case, then it has nothing to do with chocolate... No, more importantly~.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't go saying I come first all of a sudden~.
You never say things like that usually. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who gave you the chocolate, so you're making me feel embarrassed here~.
Jeez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Copano Rickey suddenly became flustered. And then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, I'll take the loss for today. The chocolate didn't seem to work, after all. But still...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win with feng shui!
I'm gonna make chocolates that'll totally bowl Trainer over!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Be prepared, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without relying on the effects of feng shui,
our hearts are already connected.
This Valentine's Day reaffirmed that.
